note: Maps a citation, written exactly as it appears in data/library.json, to the place it can be checked. A citation with no entry here is printed as plain text. kind is doi, pubmed or url. verified is the date the link was checked. For a DOI, Crossref and the DOI resolver both returned the work and its first author and year match the citation. For a PubMed link, the PubMed record's first author, title and year match. For a url, the page loaded (HTTP 200) and named the cited work. matched records what was found. Source strings that join several citations with a semicolon are split there and each part is looked up on its own. build/verify_citation_links.py re-checks the file against Crossref, the DOI resolver and the web.
